# Cheater.cz — Miky’s Czech walkthrough

- Original source: [Robin Hood - The Legend of Sherwood (návod)](https://www.cheater.cz/pc-hry/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/navod/1120/)

- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete factual notes in English (all-rights-reserved Czech walkthrough, not transcribed)

This independently attributed guide covers sixteen main missions and character abilities. Its introduction excludes detailed forest robbery walkthroughs. The opening emphasizes scrolls, beggar information, and manipulating the archery target to clear a route; later passages cover Robin’s rescue, the York missions, and the final Nottingham confrontation.

The inspected character section identifies Stuteley’s unlocking and binding abilities, and describes limits on Robin’s money-bag distraction. This provides another Czech comparison source alongside Roman Ficnar’s guide. Some mission instructions are very brief, and not every route or character entry was inspected.

### Introduction and story (A) Příběh)

- Scope: the guide covers the main missions that take place in castles. It mentions but does not describe the other mission type, the robbery missions (loupeživé) set only in Sherwood forest, whose goal is to obtain money or blazons (erby).
- Story: King Richard the Lionheart is on crusade; his brother John (Jan) rules England unjustly, supported by the Sheriff of Nottingham and henchmen. Robin Hood returned from the crusade to find his property confiscated and leads the outlaws (zbojníci). Richard is imprisoned and his captors demand a ransom of 100,000 pounds; Robin and his companions decide to raise it.

### Walkthrough (B) Návod), 16 missions

1. **Back in England (Zpět v Anglii).** Objectives: get into the castle to Godwin; talk to the nephew of Godwin's friend. Advice: always collect scrolls (svitky), which give useful hints in every mission. Climb up to the arrows and shoot the archery target; the soldiers leave, opening the way to the beggar. Beggars know a lot; give them a gold coin for information. Reach Godwin's chambers; he is absent, so talk to his friend, who refers you to the nephew. Eliminate guards on the way, talk to the nephew, and he leads you out of the town.
2. **Nottingham - rescue of Stuteley (záchrana Stuteleyho).** Objectives: save Stuteley and his friends; escape to Sherwood. Start under the Nottingham walls; get to Stuteley at the execution site as fast as possible and free him and his friends; kill a few guards and take the southern route to Sherwood. Note: Sherwood is the forest where items are crafted and soldiers trained (use the scroll there to learn what is done where); missions are launched from it and important items are kept there.
3. **Nottingham - meeting Marian (setkání s Marianou).** Objective: talk to Marian. The main gate is closed, so run around along the walls, unlock the side gate and then the main gate with Robin, who sneaks into the town unseen. Go to the church and talk to the beggar, who says Marian goes to church. Beat up the monk, tie him up and hide him in the sacristy (the monk's room). Put Robin into the confessional and watch the conversation. Leave the castle by the north gate, where resistance is weakest.
4. **Leicester - freeing Will Scarlet (osvobození Willa Scarleta).** Objective: free Robin's nephew Will Scarlet. The castle gate is closed. With Robin, go along the walls to a spot with ivy and a stone that lets him jump the moat and climb the walls; cut the rope at the main gate to open it. Before entering, talk to the peasant at the mill near where Robin climbed over; he tells you about an oppressed beggar. Free the beggar by killing the guards around him; he reveals where Will is hidden. Go through the gate to the tower, unlock the way to Will; he tells you about a secret entrance, which you use to escape to Sherwood.
5. **Derby - meeting John (setkání s Janem).** Objectives: find John; steal the sceptre. Marian arranged the meeting, so you must reach John's chambers. Use Robin to get into the town, then bring in the others. Clear the enemy in the lower town, move along the walls to the next part of the fortification, kill the soldiers on the walls and open the next gate. Take Marian and Robin to the top of the highest tower and through the door onto the balcony of the hall where the council is held. After the conversation Marian learns Prince John is not one of the good ones; leave. Do not forget the building on the right, where the royal sceptre is stolen. Return to Sherwood.
6. **Leicester - meeting Ranulph (setkání s Ranulphem).** Objectives: reach Ranulph; none of Ranulph's soldiers may be killed; find out why the Sheriff's soldiers are also on guard here. Nobody may be killed: stun and tie up enemies. Go to the small village in the east and beat up the soldiers; cross the stream to the south and continue to the mill; behind it is the house with the secret passage into the castle from the earlier mission. It comes out almost in the middle of the castle near the courtyard. Beat up the local soldiers, then take Robin to the house in the north; after the conversation the soldiers are on your side, but the Sheriff's men remain and may be killed. Take the book from the tower behind them. Return to Sherwood.
7. **Lincoln - meeting Godwin (setkání s Godwinem).** Objectives: free Godwin; free Godwin's soldiers; kill the enemies. Godwin is held in the dungeons of his own castle. Ask beggars and help people. Use the ivy on the eastern wall, cut the ropes at the gate and let the rest of the party in. Reach the dungeons in the west; use Robin to talk to Godwin, who says his soldiers are also captive: enter every door in front of which a red scroll appeared and release the soldiers. Then eliminate the enemy or leave it to Godwin's soldiers.
8. **Derby - freeing Brother Tuck (osvobození bratra Tucka).** Objectives: free Brother Tuck; get into the chambers and overhear the conversation. Climb the scaffolding onto the walls and stun the guards; go to the highest tower in the north-east where Tuck is, and free him with Robin. Collect food in the hall on the right, enter the main building and listen to the conversation. Return to Sherwood.
9. **Defence (Obrana).** A defensive mission with several ways to win: buy blazons, send soldiers, go and warn allies, or play a mission that yields a blazon. There are several such missions; the author does not describe them further.
10. **Derby - siege (obléhání).** Objective: obtain all blazons. The first conquest mission. Blazons are placed around the map; each has an associated task to complete. Allies help but sometimes cannot manage alone. Finally kill the commander on the tower.
11. **Nottingham - archery contest (střelecká soutěž).** Objectives: win the archery contest; talk to Marian; defeat the Sheriff; escape. Start in the courtyard competing for the silver arrow: aim at the target and shoot. After the dialogue defeat the Sheriff and run up the tower to Marian. After the next dialogue run down onto the walls and along them to the first gate, where the contest rival is; he jumps over the wall, follow him, talk to him and he joins you. Free his friends to complete the party. Before leaving, go to the church in the east where Marian was first met and take the next piece of the crown jewels, the sword. Go to the north gate; with Robin go along the walls to the place where the silver arrow is, then leave the town by the north gate.
12. **York - wedding (svatba).** Objectives: prevent the wedding between Marian and the Sheriff; raise Richard's banner on the highest tower; get into the cathedral. Start at the market; go east to the tower with the flag. Take Robin onto the eastern walls and north along them to a small fort; climb the ivy from the walls and beat up the soldiers in the fort; climb the tower and swap the flags, which confuses the guards at the cathedral so they partly disperse. Best route into the cathedral: continue from the fort along the northern walls, through the gate and a door into the courtyard behind the cathedral; beat up and tie the soldiers, then send Robin inside. Lure out the black guards and help Robin eliminate them, then fight the Sheriff. Leave the castle and flee to Sherwood.
13. **Nottingham - Robin captured (Robin v zajetí).** Objectives: free Robin; beat up the wretch who informed on Robin and find his residence (only beggars know it). Go with everyone to the prison by the castle, a separate building left of the walls; clear it, but Robin is not there. A prisoner says Robin is in other dungeons and shows them. Enter the castle by the right-hand path around the church; at the north gate climb the walls and free Robin. Climb to the royal chambers and steal the seal. Leave through the north gate to Sherwood.
14. **York - ransom for Richard (výkupné za Richarda).** Objectives: find our helper; get into the fortress; kill Longchamps (spelled "Longshamps" in the guide); carry his body outside the walls. Climb out of the harbour and reach the gate in the north; go along the walls to the fortress and climb down using the roofs of the houses. Run around the fortress, kill the guards, climb the walls again in the east, reach the spy and talk to him. Return to the walls and climb the ivy into the fortress; beat the guards and kill Longchamps. Unlock the gate and take his body to Sherwood. Warning that hordes of soldiers remain in the area.
15. **York - attack on the castle (útok na hrad).** Objective: obtain all blazons. Same as before; reinforcements are called by raising the flag on the highest tower and by ringing the bells in the cathedral.
16. **Nottingham - final battle (poslední boj).** Objective: kill the Sheriff and capture John. Join both groups as fast as possible and clear the whole castle; there are very many soldiers, so use every hiding place such as shadows and houses. Climb the towers into the royal chambers, kill the Sheriff and watch the final conversation.

### Heroes (C) Popis vašich hrdinů)

| Hero | Main weapon | Secondary items | Skills |
|---|---|---|---|
| Robin Hood | sword or staff | bow (one-shot kills at range, ineffective against chain-mail soldiers, can trigger mechanisms by hitting targets); fist (stuns); full purse (thrown among enemies they fight over it until one is left collecting coins; nullified if guards are smarter or a commander is nearby) | climbing ivy; jumping across roofs (useful for escapes); jumping onto smaller buildings from the ground |
| Stuteley | axe | net (entangles a victim, but a nearby enemy removes it); bitten apple (thrown at an enemy's head to make him turn); begging (disguise as a beggar to avoid guards) | unlocking most locked doors; tying up stunned enemies |
| Brother Tuck | small mace | wasp nest (thrown; the victim only cares about getting wasps out of his armour); beer (place on the ground, whoever picks it up staggers drunk); leg of lamb (eaten by the holder to restore health instantly) | tying up; unlocking |
| Will Scarlet | flail (řemdih) | sling (aim at a head to stun); strangling (kills an enemy bare-handed); shield (taken off the back to block arrows: select the shield, click on yourself, then on the archer's position or behind it; you rotate around that point, so if the enemy moves the shield must be re-set) | jumping across roofs; jumping onto buildings; shield on the back deflects arrows when not active; clubbing (can kill a stunned enemy on the ground) |
| Little John (Malý John) | pole | whistle (attracts or at least confuses enemies in the area); fist; boost (hands together to lift an agile character, Robin or Will, to higher places) | strength (carries dead or stunned soldiers); revival (revives stunned allies) |
| Marian (Mariana) | sword | bow; healing herbs (heals any wound of companions); eavesdropping (ear to the wall to tell whether anyone is in the room) | none listed |

### Soldiers (D) Popis vašich vojáků)

| Soldier | Main weapon | Secondary items | Skills |
|---|---|---|---|
| Peasant with pitchfork (Sedlák s vidlemi) | pitchfork | bitten apple; healing herbs | clubbing |
| Helper with mace (Pomocník s palcátem) | mace | whistle; leg of lamb | strength; rolling (rolls stones or tree trunks onto enemies) |
| Peasant with bow (Rolník s lukem) | sword | bow; shield | tying up |
